## Weekly Update - 2026-09-06

Hey <@&1424461167883194418> — 140 merges this week. The garden got noticeably larger.

🤖 **Responses, agents, and tools**
- The stateless `Responses API` is now a first-class route across text models, with streaming and structured managed-agent output.
- Managed agents can use MCP tools; Composio connectors landed, plus hosted MCP docs and Pollinations MCP for Open WebUI.
- `polli` gained Pi, OpenCode, Prime Agent, and OpenClaw harness profiles.

🌻 **Community models became a media shelf**
- Community publishing now supports `/embeddings`, video, and speech/TTS modalities.
- Play shows community-model uptime, categories are fully visible, and queued changes are easier to follow.
- Wan routes inputs across T2V, I2V, and R2V. Media has opinions now.

🧰 **More things to plug in**
- Open WebUI can run with Pollinations login, and there’s an OpenAI-compatible streaming path for Polli.
- Model lists sort by popularity; filters moved into search; MCP servers and pricing sit beside models.

✨ **Fresh catalog pollen**
`GPT-6 Astra`, `Mercury 2.5 Preview`, `Gemini 3.8 Flash`, `DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision`, `Claude Fable 5.1`, `Qwen3.8 Max/Flash`, `MAI Image 2.5 Flash`, Azure `FLUX.2 Pro/Flex`, and MiniMax H3 Max Turbo all joined.

Reliability work also tightened fallbacks, timeouts, streaming errors, and rate-limit handling — the unglamorous load-bearing kind.

Docs: https://docs.pollinations.ai • Code: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations
